verses.gurmukhi: ਰਜ ਤਮ ਸਤ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਹੰਕਾਰ ਹਾਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਬਾਨ ਕ੍ਰਾਂਤਿ ਨਿਹਕ੍ਰਾਂਤਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: raj tam sat kaam krodh lobh moh ha(n)kaar haar gur giaan baan kraa(n)t nihakraa(n)t hai ||

en.bdb: By virtue of initiation by the Guru and practicing of meditation on the Lord's name, all the traits of maya (Raja, Sato, Tamo) and vices like lust, anger, avarice, attachment and pride are defeated. Their influence also becomes negligible.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਨਿਹਕਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਆਸਾ ਕੈ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਭਏ ਭ੍ਰਾਂਤਿ ਨਿਹਭ੍ਰਾਂਤਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: kaam nihakaam nihakaram karam gat aasaa kai niraas bhe bhraa(n)t nihabhraa(n)t hai ||

en.bdb: With the acquisition of Guru's knowledge, a Guru-oriented person loses attachment with all desires, and all his actions become benevolent. All his worldly desires end and his wandering stops.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਨਿਹ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਅਰੁ ਬਾਦ ਨਿਹ ਬਾਦ ਭਏ ਅਸੰ ਪ੍ਰੇਹ ਨਿਸਪ੍ਰੇਹ ਦੇਹ ਗੇਹ ਪਾਂਤਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: savaiaadh neh savaiaadh ar baadh neh baadh bhe asa(n) preh nisapreh dheh geh paa(n)t hai ||

en.bdb: A Guru-oriented person becomes free of all attachments and relishments by virtue of Guru's teachings. Engrossed in Naam Simran, he does not indulge in other debates and arguments. He becomes totally desireless and contended. His attachment with worldly attractions ends.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਦੇਹ ਸਿਖ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੈ ਉਦਾਸ ਬਾਸ ਏਕਾਕੀ ਏਕਾਂਤਿ ਹੈ ॥੨੭੨॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh prem ras bisam bidheh sikh maiaa mai udhaas baas ekaakee ekaa(n)t hai ||272||

en.bdb: By virtues of Naam Simran, a follower of Guru's teachings become free of all his body needs. He remains in a state of . trance and unsullied in maya. He is ever engrossed in the memory of the Lord. (272)
